column1: # Golden address set: real Victorian addresses as people type them.
# Expected is the street address (number|street_name|street_type|locality), not
# a PID: G-NAF holds one PID per unit, so any PID at the right street address
# is a correct answer. A fifth part names the row instead: "unit N", "lot N"
# for a lot with no street number, or empty for the base address (no unit).
# Coarser answers are the candidate ID (street:..., locality:...,
# postcode:...), prefixed "BOX@" for a postal box (PO BOX 1@locality:...), and
# (none) means /resolve must decline so the ladder moves on to POI search.
# Coarse, postal and (none) rows are /resolve only.
# CI runs this against testdata/golden_fixture.tsv.gz (built by
# short street numbers on long streets (generation cap truncation)
# "St" meaning Saint, in street names and localities
# street types outside the common set, and "The ..." streets
# units, case, typos (no unit 2 at 36 Collins or unit 3 at 313 Sydney Rd: any
# units pick their own row; without one, the base address
Apt 1205, 469 St Kilda Rd Melbourne VIC 3004
# lots with no street number (2 Wellington St, Wallan is also a street number)
# postal boxes: G-NAF has no location for one, so the locality (or postcode)
# it is addressed to, marked as a postal box. 3001 holds no street address.
# no street number, or no street: answered at street, locality or postcode
# not addresses: /resolve declines and the ladder moves on
# G-NAF locality and street aliases answer as the official name. There is no
# MELBOURNE CBD alias in G-NAF (August 2026); JOLIMONT, BALLARAT and MORELAND
# levels pick the level's own row ("level N": a level with no unit); without a
# level, the base address as before
# postcodes: a PO box postcode with no address or postal area answers at the
# locality internal/postbox maps it to; an unmapped one (3050 ROYAL MELBOURNE
# HOSPITAL, 8003 COLLINS STREET EAST) declines. 3551's address average lies
# outside its postal area, so its answer is the area's representative point.
